tools.name: get_editor_status
tools.description: Read connection, instance, session_id, editor_revision, current_scene_id, playback_state (editing/playing/paused), legacy playing (true for Playing and Paused), and protocol version. Start here.

playing.description: True throughout a runtime session, including Paused.

tools.name: get_scene_state
tools.description: Read edit scene list and stable EDIT snapshots, also during Playing/Paused; never runtime entity IDs. Includes playback_state and legacy playing. Default page=50 (max=200); cursors expire when revision changes. Transforms are local engine units/degrees; lights expose their own scene-space position.

playing.description: True throughout a runtime session, including Paused.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List loaded model/texture/music/soundfx/shader keys. Does not import files. Use a returned model key in create_object.

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create and activate an empty edit scene with a Windows-safe, case-insensitively unique name. Generate assets/scripts/<name>.lua only if absent; reuse existing contents. Undo retains the Lua file. Requires current session/revision and a new request_id. Writes are rejected during Playing and Paused.

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Create a visible mesh from a loaded model key, or an enabled default point light. Name is not identity; use returned entity_id.

name.description: Required display name for each new object; names may repeat.

model.description: Required for mesh: an exact loaded model key from list_assets. Omit for light.

tools.name: set_transform
tools.description: Update local position, XYZ Euler rotation_degrees, or positive scale. Engine units; no world space. Physical root objects support pose but reject scale edits. For light position use set_light instead.

tools.name: set_light
tools.description: Update an existing light. Scene-space position is independent of Transform. Linear RGB 0..1, intensity 0..10000. Nonzero direction; area half-sizes .001..4.999. Only type-applicable fields allowed.

tools.name: set_material
tools.description: Partially update an existing material slot. Query get_scene_state materials/material_index first. Linear RGB color[3], separate alpha, metallic/roughness/ao all 0..1. textures maps loaded 2D keys or null to clear; use_texture changes only when explicit. No slot creation or shading_model edit. Undoable; supports batches.

tools.name: add_physics
tools.description: Edit Physics on a root entity with Transform in non-playing mode. Supports box/sphere/capsule, static/dynamic/kinematic. Pose uses set_transform; collider dimensions are engine units independent of visual scale. Values are applied immediately and undoable.

tools.name: set_physics
tools.description: Edit Physics on a root entity with Transform in non-playing mode. Supports box/sphere/capsule, static/dynamic/kinematic. Pose uses set_transform; collider dimensions are engine units independent of visual scale. Values are applied immediately and undoable.

tools.name: remove_physics
tools.description: Edit Physics on a root entity with Transform in non-playing mode. Supports box/sphere/capsule, static/dynamic/kinematic. Pose uses set_transform; collider dimensions are engine units independent of visual scale. Values are applied immediately and undoable.

tools.name: delete_entity
tools.description: Delete a recoverable entity. cascade defaults false; children require explicit true. Unsupported components are rejected. Undo restores fresh public IDs; source assets remain loaded.

tools.name: apply_operations
tools.description: Atomically apply 1..32 actions in the current scene. Each item has method and params. create_object params require name and kind; mesh also requires model (the loaded asset key). Example creation: {"method":"create_object","params":{"name":"Display Model","kind":"mesh","model":"cube","client_ref":"model"}}. For a light use name, kind=light and optional client_ref. Later set_transform/set_light params use entity_id OR an earlier creation's target_ref, plus the fields to update. One revision and one undo history entry; no scene creation inside a batch.

name.description: Required display name for each new object; names may repeat.

model.description: Required for mesh: an exact loaded model key from list_assets. Omit for light.

tools.name: undo_operation
tools.description: Undo the current undo stack top using its original content operation_id. Manual edits/context changes clear both stacks. Scene entries require the current scene_id; scene lifecycle/global entries may omit it. Use get_history before traversing.

tools.name: get_operation_status
tools.description: Look up queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled by original session_id/request_id after a timeout or reconnect. Never blindly resend as a NEW write.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read current edit-scene single selection: entity_id/name or null, scene_id and selection_serial. Use the returned explicit entity_id in content edits. Does not change content revision or undo.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Select one entity in the current edit scene, or pass entity_id=null to clear. Synchronizes hierarchy, GO Details and Gizmo. Requires write preconditions and request dedup; does not change content revision or consume content undo. Its receipt operation_id is NOT undoable. No multi-select or camera focus.

tools.name: capture_viewport
tools.description: Read a fresh Scene-camera PNG of the current Editing scene (Playing and Paused return play_mode), including when Game tab is active. No UI/Gizmo, file writes or camera changes. Default 640x360; integer width/height 64..1024, proportionally reduced to 230400 pixels. Returns image/png plus actual dimensions/frame_id/camera/session/revision. One in flight; capture_busy/timeout/unavailable are explicit. Does not consume undo.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Read ordered undo/redo entries, original content operation IDs, scope, counts and memory limits. Cursors expire on revision or history changes.

tools.name: redo_operation
tools.description: Redo the current redo stack top using its original content operation_id. Returns fresh IDs when recreating entities or scenes. Does not replay the original request.

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an absolute local model/2D texture/music/soundfx file, or vertex+fragment Shader files, under an explicit unused asset_key. Loads this session only; never copies or modifies source files. Global scope; no scene_id. Model dependencies commit atomically. May return pending; query the original request. Undo/redo retain original payloads.
